provenance: Generated by scripts/bench-claim-source.mjs against Citation-Integrity (100 biomedical papers, real citing sentences). Measures D1's VERDICT LOGIC and GROUNDING FILTER on expert-labelled data; it does NOT measure candidate generation on real submissions, which is a separate number. Precision on the fires class is the headline: a false positive lands on someone's manuscript. Gold labels are the dataset's, not ours, so unlike the other files here this one does not need human adjudication.

false_positives.claim: recent mouse studies [] investigating how consumption of red meat may accelerate cardiovascular disease and inflammation in humans
false_positives.source_quote: (a) Structure of carnitine and scheme of carnitine and choline metabolism to TMAO.

what_was_NOT_exercised.refutation_pass: This harness calls judgeClaimAgainstSource() directly (scripts/bench-claim-source.mjs:172,225), NOT checkClaimSource(), so the shipped INDEPENDENT REFUTATION CALL was never run. The 0.944 measures the verdict logic plus the verbatim-quote grounding filter, which is what the provenance line says — but it is not the full shipped path, and that omission was not stated until 2026-08-21.
what_was_NOT_exercised.which_direction_the_bound_runs: Refutation can only DROP findings, never add them. So on the shipped path precision can only rise and recall can only fall: 0.944 is a LOWER bound on shipped precision and 0.215 an UPPER bound on shipped recall. Quote them as bounds, not as the shipped numbers.
what_was_NOT_exercised.refutation_has_no_production_evidence: The refutation gate has never been measured end to end on labelled data. It is justified by design and by unit tests, not by a number.
what_was_NOT_exercised.refutation_measured_2026_08_22: Since measured — see bench-refutation.json. Replaying all 20 fired findings through the verbatim shipped refutation prompt killed 4 of 17 true positives and 0 of 3 false positives, taking precision from 0.850 to 0.813 on that subset. So the 'lower bound on shipped precision' framing above may be backwards: on this sample the gate LOWERS precision. n=20, and the replay saw only the source_quote rather than the full abstract, so it is not yet a verdict.

sample_caveat_2026_08_22: PSEUDO-REPLICATED: the harness pushes one case per evidence-SENTENCE annotation, so the 240 rows contain only 149 unique (claim, doc) pairs — 91 exact duplicates (FIRES: 51 unique of 80; ACCURATE: 37 of 65). Precision/recall are therefore weighted toward multi-sentence-evidence cases and effective n is 149, not 240. Found by the 2026-08-22 accuracy review; fix the sampler before the next run.
